notes.title: Update #1 FIRE AND ASHES
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we are happy to announce that in the game FIRE AND ASHES continues to work hard to improve the mechanism of voice interaction, new techniques are added to the game, we are focused on the development of voice interaction in the game to maximize the immersion of the player in the role of the main character of FIRE AND ASHES

In this short video we demonstrate voice interaction with the enemy, the player's shouts of anger will help him in the game to dominate the enemy and finish him off!
